mapper.sql: SELECT MEMBER_NO memberNo , MEMBER_ID memberId , MEMBER_PWD memberPwd , NICKNAME , EMAIL , ADDRESS_LINE_1 addressLine1 , ADDRESS_LINE_2 addressLine2 , ROLE , ENROLL_DATE enrollDate FROM CL_MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE STATUS = 'N' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE CL_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.sql: WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY ENROLL_DATE DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
